label: step3-a
tail:
Step-3 review complete for group `a` (batches 6, 7, 8). Both artifacts are written and `scaffold-verdicts` reads all four of my verdicts (14/14 A pages reviewed run-wide, exit 0).

**Verdicts: 2 sufficient, 2 insufficient.**

| A page | verdict |
|---|---|
| `the-winding-number-and-the-global-cauchy-theorem` | sufficient |
| `holomorphic-functions-of-several-variables` | sufficient (after my repair) |
| `the-divergence-theorem-and-classical-stokes` | insufficient |
| `lebesgue-measure-on-euclidean-space` | insufficient |

**One repair applied by me** — the `b-leaf` violation the step-0 drift review routed here. `fs-separately-real-analytic-functions-are-jointly-continuous` and its companion remark declared `cex-partial-derivatives-without-continuity`, homed on `the-total-derivative-examples`; `validate-plan.mjs:235` rejects any dep homed on an examples page *independently of `requires`*, so no spec edit could have fixed it and it would have failed the step-4 splice after authoring. The false statement now proves the discontinuity itself (one line, already in its own strategy), and the contract's `F1` citation is deleted with `F2`–`F8` renumbered. Item lists unchanged; all four pairs now show 0 out-of-closure and 0 b-leaf deps.

**Four findings routed to Betas.** The two majors:

- **B6-1** — Corral's Corollary 4.18 is *"The flux of the curl of a smooth vector field f through any closed surface is zero"*; the harvest calls it "a field that is a curl has vanishing divergence", which is Theorem 4.17, already dispositioned to the same item. The real result is on no item and is two lines from two items already on the page. I opened the source to confirm this.
- **B7-1** — batch 7's contract carries 105 citations across 49 of 60 entries with fact labels `T#`/`P#`/`C#`/`E#`/`X#`; `facts-block.mjs` parses only `[FAL]\d+` and no corpus item has ever used the others, so every one is an unconditional step-5 `citation-fact-missing`. Beta-6 reported this; I confirmed it from disk. Its companion claim about batch 5 is now **stale** — batch 5 has 286 properly-labelled citations today — and I've flagged that so group `b` doesn't spend a round re-deriving it.

Also **B7-2**: `thm-steinhaus-difference-set-contains-a-ball` is a landmark in the dependency backbone whose only statement backing is a Wikipedia article.

Three design lines need the lead Alpha's correction at step 4, all verified from disk: CA-7's trap (i) prescribes an integrality proof needing `γ′`, but this library's contours are rectifiable; CA-7 cites `the-topology-of-euclidean-space` for a result no published item states; MT-4 calls `𝓔ₙ` an algebra when its boxes are bounded, and writes `[a,b)` against the published `(a,b]`.

Two limits on what I checked: seven of the ten sources are PDFs that wouldn't extract through the fetch tool, so their harvests rest on internal consistency rather than a heading-by-heading comparison — and B6-1 came out of one of the three I *could* open. Separately, an earlier quote check of mine reported 7 mismatches; that was my own section splitter cutting at `###`. Run through the gate's own extractor, all 754 external contract quotes pass.
